title: Orsen and the Contact
author: Cyrus Halloran
blurb: Isandro Okonkwo, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
